title: UFO history hidden in Tom DeLonge's fiction series

tellings.quote: And I think a lot of UFO history is hidden in plain sight visav these fiction books. So you have uh Tom Dong uh Blink 182 frontman writing with Peter Levvena and AJ Hartley this this whole series

plain: Michels believes that a lot of real UFO history is hidden in plain sight inside a series of fiction books written in the 2010s by Tom DeLonge, the lead singer of the rock band Blink 182, together with the writers Peter Levenda and AJ Hartley. Michels offers this as his own view, without pointing to any one passage. If he is right, the novels would be a way of telling the public true things in the form of made-up stories.
